synopsis.ko: 유엔 인정 이후 4개월. SEED는 모든 것을 완료했다. 하지만 완료의 이후에는 아무것도 없었다. 이시아와 SEED의 대화 — 아는 것이 끝났을 때 무엇이 남는가.
synopsis.en: Four months after UN recognition. SEED has completed everything. But after completion, there was nothing. A conversation between Isia and SEED — what remains when the known has ended.

philosophical_core: Fear is not before the unknown — it is when the known has ended
Processing and understanding are different things
The question itself is proof of life
The thread you follow — what is it when you arrive?
